{
  "name": "receipt",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "What each turn did, in a band above the prompt once it ends (files changed with lines, commands and failures, reads, subagents), and a toast when the model goes in circles; read from the turn's own tool calls: no tool, no prompt, no tokens",
  "author": {
    "name": "hoobnn",
    "url": "https://github.com/hoobnn"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "receipt",
    "turn",
    "activity",
    "loop",
    "band",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "visible": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the receipt",
      "description": "Show the receipt above the prompt between turns; /receipt off and /receipt on set this too",
      "default": true
    },
    "repeatFailures": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Repeated failure alert",
      "description": "Toast when the same call fails this many times in a row with no file changed in between; 0 off",
      "default": 3
    },
    "flipFlops": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Back-and-forth edit alert",
      "description": "Toast when edits to a file put back what an earlier edit took out this many times; 0 off",
